**Plantable Calendar – Grow With Every Month!**

This eco-friendly calendar is made from seed paper – a biodegradable material embedded with seeds. Once a month is over, simply tear off the sheet, plant it in soil, water it regularly, and watch it grow into beautiful herbs, vegetables, or flowers. A perfect blend of sustainability and functionality, this calendar is a thoughtful gift for nature lovers, corporate giveaways, or anyone who believes in green living.
